title: Spire2 Pile Viewer
description:
See your teammates' draw, exhaust, and discard piles, and their hand, in co-op.

Cosmetic only: teammates don't need the mod.

[list]
[*] Each teammate gets a Pile Viewer next to their name with live pile counts. [b]Click[/b] a pile to open it. [b]Drag[/b] a Pile Viewer to move it, or set it to float above the characters (F1).
[*] Your teammate's hand is shown behind yours, with their live costs and playable glow. Hover a card to see it in full; drag it onto an enemy to preview its numbers.
[*] Click the eye in a Pile Viewer to switch teammates. [b]Hide hand[/b] (or H) hides your own hand to read theirs.
[*] Hotkeys: Shift+Z / V / C / H for teammate 1's draw / exhaust / discard / hand (Ctrl+ for teammate 2, Ctrl+Shift+ for teammate 3). Rebind to keys or extra mouse buttons.
[*] [b]F1[/b] for settings.
[/list]

Source: https://github.com/hanryhu/Spire2PileViewer
Architecture adapted from BetterSpire2 by jdr.
changeNote: v0.4.1: New setting 'Pile Viewer alignment': Fixed (next to the names) or Float (above the characters). Fixed Pile Viewers line up in one column next to the names and move right when a long name or a health bar grown with max HP needs the room. Float sits a little lower. Without the Hand Viewer a Pile Viewer is 3 slots wide again. Slightly bigger count badges. Resizing keeps the left edge in place. Empty-pile messages name the teammate ("The Defect's Discard Pile is empty.").
